name: Fitness Tracker
highLevelGoals: The user aims to accurately record and monitor various physical activities, both automatically and manually, to maintain a complete log of their exercise habits.
The user seeks to visualize their fitness progress over time through reports and notifications, allowing them to assess consistency, identify improvements, and stay motivated.
The user desires the ability to set, customize, and track personal fitness goals to provide clear targets and maintain focus on their fitness journey.
The user expects to receive personalized workout recommendations that adapt to their fitness level and preferences, optimizing their training for desired outcomes.
The user wants to integrate their wearable devices with the application for automatic and real-time data collection, ensuring accurate and up-to-date fitness information.
The user aims to share their fitness achievements and activities on social media to connect with friends, celebrate milestones, and foster a supportive community.
lowLevelGoals: The user can start an automatic tracking session for activities like running or cycling.
The user can input details of an activity they performed without automatic tracking.
The user can modify the information for an activity already logged in the system.
The user can access a consolidated view of their activities for a specific day.
The user can create a report summarizing their fitness activities and progress over a week.
The user gets alerts when they reach new personal records or significant achievements.
The user can define a new objective for their fitness journey.
The user can adjust the parameters of a goal they have already set.
The user can see how close they are to achieving their current fitness objectives.
The user can ask the system to generate a workout routine tailored to their current abilities and objectives.
The user can access guides and videos for performing exercises correctly.
The user can rate or comment on a workout to help the system improve its recommendations.
The user can pair their fitness tracker or smartwatch with the application.
The user can check if their wearable devices are actively syncing data.
The user can force an immediate data transfer from their wearable device.
The user can post details of their workout or activity to social media.
The user can send invitations to their contacts to use the fitness application.
The user can see updates from their friends who also use the application.
